app_name: ADHD Habit Tracker, To Do List
title: Frozen for days
body: Liked the app the first two days, after that it’s just been frozen. Hoping for that to change in the next couple of days (and it not happening again) otherwise the app is useless obviously. Shame since it has potential.
author: Speedbully

app_name: ADHD Habit Tracker, To Do List
title: Simple and effective
body: I love this app so far. It’s easy to use, the layout is great - it’s really useful. I would like to make groups or categories (other than just using the colors), as well as the option for ex “every two/three weeks/months” and so on.
author: kjaereingrid

app_name: ADHD Habit Tracker, To Do List
title: Suveren
body: Kjempeenkel, kjempemotiverende app for å komme i gang med gode vaner! Den er ikke så masete som andre apper kan være - bare akkurat nok til at du holder deg i gang.
author: SillyWQ

app_name: ADHD Habit Tracker, To Do List
title: Perfect
body: Clean, Straightforward, easy to use, and easy to set up.
author: RoninNoodle
